scope: Final build: SHOP-01–13, UX-01–06, DS-01–03, Store journeys and ONB-01–11, desktop/mobile. Six widths and reduced viewport. Real existing fictional account reads; CRUD/Storage/Auth signup operations use controlled mocks. No production business writes or email send.
limits: Not a full application audit or WCAG certification. Broader 220/224 run is recorded separately; the four legacy selector failures passed here after correction.
